data.title: What kadence adds to an agent's context is logged locally and shown by kadence hook log
data.why: The reviewer's first question was how an agent uses the context and what it costs (KAD-76). A log in the system temp directory beside the hook's seen-file shows, for the latest session, what prime and each prompt got and its size, after the fact, at no cost to the agent. Nothing in git, no network; prompts are kept to 80 characters.
data.rejected: A flag on hook prompt: shows one prompt, only at the moment it runs; A size footer on prime: costs tokens every session and says nothing about prompts
